title: Vitis vinifera tea for medicinal use
intro: Vitis vinifera tea is a herbal preparation made from the leaves of the grapevine plant, which is known for its traditional use in herbal medicine. This tea is often used to support cardiovascular health and may help lower blood pressure due to its high content of antioxidants and flavonoids. In herbalism, it is also valued for its potential to improve circulation and reduce inflammation. It is typically prepared by steeping the dried leaves in hot water and consumed as a calming infusion. This preparation is commonly used in complementary medicine to promote overall wellness and support heart-related conditions.
